questionText:
Read the following case review on digital media convergence and audio storytelling and answer the questions that follow:

In the autumn of 2014, WBEZ Chicago and the creators of public radio's 'This American Life' launched 'Serial', an investigative audio documentary hosted by journalist Sarah Koenig. Re-examining the 1999 murder of high school student Hae Min Lee and the conviction of her ex-boyfriend Adnan Syed, Serial became an unprecedented global cultural phenomenon, surpassing 100 million downloads in record time and single-handedly propelling podcasting from a niche tech hobby into the cultural mainstream. The triumph of Serial highlighted the revolutionary features of the digital podcast medium. Unlike linear broadcast radio, which is bound by rigid program grids, fixed clocks, and regional transmitter towers, podcasting operates through decentralized RSS (Really Simple Syndication) feeds, allowing asynchronous on-demand streaming and downloads. Listeners consumed Serial predominantly through personal headphones, forging an intense, private parasocial intimacy with Sarah Koenig's conversational investigative monologue. detailedSolution:

Hence Option A is correct.

questionText:
Match the digital media attribute in List-I with its technological hallmark in List-II:

List I:
(A) Interactivity
(B) Multimediality
(C) Hypertextuality
(D) Asynchronicity

List II:
(I) Two-way responsive dialogue between user and digital interface
(II) Seamless integration of text, photography, sound, animation, and video
(III) Networked non-linear nodes of information connected by hyperlinks
(IV) Content accessed, shared, and consumed at times chosen by user rather than live schedule

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

options.text: A-I, B-III, C-IV, D-II
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.text: A-II, B-I, C-III, D-IV
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

options.text: A-IV, B-II, C-I, D-III
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

options.text: A-I, B-II, C-III, D-IV
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Correctly maps each entity across columns.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Interactivity = responsive user dialogue; Multimediality = integrated sensory media; Hypertextuality = hyperlinked nodes; Asynchronicity = time-shifted on-demand access.
Hence Option B is correct.
Hence, option (D) is the correct match.
